from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys
base=Path('/workspace/.artifacts/agent-worklog/2026-09-09/issue659')
root=Path('/tmp/omoikane-issue659')
variant=sys.argv[1]
out=base/'profiles'/variant
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR='/target',CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='1',CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'],cwd=root)
(out/'source.patch').write_bytes(patch)
with (out/'build.stderr').open('w') as err, (out/'build.jsonl').open('w') as log:
 subprocess.run(['cargo','test','--locked','--features','baseline-jit','--test','js_benchmark','--test','browser_journeys','--no-run','--message-format=json'],cwd=root,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=err,check=True)
items=[json.loads(s) for s in (out/'build.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
native=set()
for item in items:
 if item.get('reason')=='build-script-executed':native.update(item.get('linked_paths',[]))
 if item.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and item.get('executable'):
  shutil.copy2(item['executable'],out/item['target']['name'])
lib=next(i for i in items if i.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and i['target']['name']=='omoikane' and 'rlib' in i['target']['kind'])
assert 'baseline-jit' in lib['features']
rlib=next(p for p in lib['filenames'] if p.endswith('.rlib'))
command=['rustc','--edition=2024','-C','opt-level=1','-C','debug-assertions=yes','-C','debuginfo=2',str(base/'profile-workloads.rs'),'--extern','omoikane='+rlib,'-L','dependency=/target/debug/deps','-o',str(out/'profile-workloads-debug')]
for path in sorted(native):command+=['-L',path]
with (out/'driver-build.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=log,check=True)
shutil.copy2(out/'profile-workloads-debug',out/'profile-workloads')
subprocess.run(['objcopy','--strip-debug',str(out/'profile-workloads')],check=True)
assert patch==subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'],cwd=root)
identity={'variant':variant,'base':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'patch_sha256':sha(out/'source.patch'),'worktree':str(root),'rustc':subprocess.check_output(['rustc','-Vv'],text=True),'features':lib['features'],'profile':lib['profile'],'lock_sha256':sha(root/'Cargo.lock'),'engine_lock_sha256':sha(root/'engine/boa/Cargo.lock'),'fixture_sha256':sha(root/'tests/js_benchmark/history/shapes-v1.js'),'driver_sha256':sha(base/'profile-workloads.rs'),'command':command,'binaries':{name:sha(out/name) for name in ['profile-workloads','profile-workloads-debug','js_benchmark','browser_journeys']}}
(out/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')
print(variant,'binaries preserved',flush=True)

import datetime,hashlib,json,os,statistics,subprocess,time

root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
old=Path('/workspace/.artifacts/agent-worklog/2026-09-09/issue515/performance-pointer-sets')
identity=json.loads((old/'identity.json').read_text())
manifest=json.loads((old/'binaries/manifest.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for record in manifest: assert sha(record['binary'])==record['sha256'],record['binary']
paths=[Path('/tmp/omoikane-issue553-reference'),Path('/tmp/omoikane-issue553-pointer-sets')]
inputs={}
for path in paths:
 assert sha(path/'tests/js_benchmark/shapes.js')==identity['fixture_sha256']

 assert sha(path/'engine/boa/Cargo.lock')==identity['engine_lock_sha256']
 assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=path)
 inputs[str(path)]=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=path,text=True).strip()
plan={'pairs':10,'mode':'baseline-jit','fixture':'v1','identity':identity,'binary_manifest':manifest,'current_worktree_heads':inputs,'order':'reference/candidate for even pair; candidate/reference for odd pair','method':'same preserved executables; original 11 workloads/counts and minimum of four passes; fresh process per sample; retain every run; no concurrent builds/profiling'}

env=dict(os.environ,OMOIKANE_JS_BENCH_RUNS='1',OMOIKANE_BENCH_ENVIRONMENT='local')

 order=['reference','candidate'] if pair%2==0 else ['candidate','reference']
 for variant in order:

  start=time.monotonic()
  with (folder/'benchmark.log').open('w') as log: result=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  record={'pair':pair,'variant':variant,'order':order,'exit':result.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'report':str(folder/'benchmark.json')}
  index.append(record);(root/'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(index,indent=2)+'\n')
  if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
  data=json.loads((folder/'benchmark.json').read_text());assert data['measurement_runs']==1 and len(data['shapes'])==11 and data['jit_diagnostics']['enabled']
 print(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'pair',pair,'completed',flush=True)
summary={}
for name in [s['id'] for s in data['shapes']]:
 ratios=[]
 for pair in range(10):
  values={v:next(s['ns_per_op'] for s in json.loads((root/str(pair)/v/'benchmark.json').read_text())['shapes'] if s['id']==name) for v in ['reference','candidate']}
  ratios.append(values['candidate']/values['reference']-1)
 summary[name]={'median_change':statistics.median(ratios),'slower_pairs':sum(r>0 for r in ratios),'paired_changes':ratios}
for record in manifest:assert sha(record['binary'])==record['sha256']
